Name | Symbols | Definition
:-------------- | ------ | ----------
[Probability density function (PDF)](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-pdf) | $\f(t), \p(t)$ | $\p(T=t)$
[Cumulative distribution function (CDF)](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-cdf) |$\cdf(t), \P(t)$ | $\P(T\leq t)$
[Survival function](intro-to-survival-analysis.qmd#def-surv-fn) | $\surv(t), \bar{\cdf}(t)$ | $\P(T > t)$
[Hazard function](intro-to-survival-analysis.qmd#def-hazard) | $\lambda(t), \h(t)$ | $\p(T=t|T\ge t)$
[Cumulative hazard function](intro-to-survival-analysis.qmd#def-cuhaz) | $\Lambda(t), \H(t)$ | $\int_{u=-\infty}^t \haz(u)du$
[Log-hazard function](proportional-hazards-models.qmd#def-loghaz) | $\loghaz(t)$ | $\logf{\haz(t)}$
